items.claim: Lemos has lost back-to-back fights against strong pressure grapplers and recent losses to high-level grapplers.
items.quote: Lemos has lost back-to-back fights against strong pressure grapplers.

items.claim: Grasso has the style to give Lemos trouble with takedowns and will control the fight.
items.quote: Grasso is a good athletic prospect. Yeah, I know. She's 10 years younger. And I feel like she's got the style to give Lemos, a 39-year-old Lemos, a lot of trouble with takedowns.

items.claim: Amanda Lemos has okay takedown defense but never really puts it all together against grapplers.
items.quote: She has okay takedown defense. She knows how to split the legs and face the face the hand and get some wrist control, but she never really puts it all together.

items.claim: Amanda Lemos has two career submission losses.
items.quote: Something to note about Amanda Lemosh as a pro, two submission losses
